items.source: This functional interface extends PropertyPath to provide compile-time type safety and refactoring support. Instead of using string-based property paths for textual property representation that are easy to miss when changing the domain model, TypedPropertyPath leverages Java's declarative method references to ensure type-safe property access.
items.translation: 该功能接口扩展了PropertyPath，以提供编译时类型安全和重构支持。 与使用基于字符串的属性路径来文本化表示属性（在更改领域模型时容易遗漏）不同，TypedPropertyPath利用 Java 的声明式方法引用来确保类型安全的属性访问。

items.source: The generic type parameters preserve type information across the property path chain: T represents the owning type of the current segment (or the root type for composed paths), while P represents the property value type at this segment. Composition automatically flows type information forward, ensuring that then() preserves the full chain's type safety.
items.translation: 泛型类型参数在属性路径链中保留类型信息：T 表示当前段（或组合路径的根）的所有者类型，而 P 表示该段的属性值类型。组合会自动将类型信息向前传递，确保 then() 保持整个链的类型安全性。

items.source: Implement TypedPropertyPath using method references (strongly recommended)s that directly access a property getter. Constructor references, method calls with parameters, and complex expressions are not supported and result in PropertyResolutionException. Unlike method references, introspection of lambda expressions requires bytecode analysis of the declaration site classes and thus depends on their availability at runtime.
items.translation: 使用直接访问属性获取器的方法引用实现 TypedPropertyPath（强烈推荐）。不支持构造函数引用、带参数的方法调用以及复杂表达式，这些会导致抛出 PropertyResolutionException。与使用 lambda 表达式的方法引用不同，对 lambda 表达式的内省需要分析声明位类的字节码，因此依赖于这些类在运行时的可用性。

Returns an Iterator of PropertyPath that iterates over all property path segments. For example: 
PropertyPath path = PropertyPath.from("address.city.name", Person.class);
path.forEach(p -> p.toDotPath());
results in the dot paths: 
address.city.name     (this object)
city.name             (next() object)
name             (next().next() object)

city.name             (next() 对象)
name             (next().next() 对象)
